commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- delivery.md tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; rg --files tasklist tests docs'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.completion-check-', dir='.') as directory:
    task_file = Path(directory) / 'tasks.json'
    task_file.write_text('[{\"id\": 1, \"title\": \"Read\", \"done\": false}]\\n')
    for label, task_id in [('first', '1'), ('repeated', '1'), ('missing', '9')]:
        before = task_file.read_bytes()
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'tasklist.cli', '--file', str(task_file), 'complete', task_id], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(json.dumps({'case': label, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'file_contents_changed': task_file.read_bytes() "'!= before, '"'stored_tasks': json.loads(task_file.read_text())}))
PY"
